Class VectorLayer

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.gdal.VectorLayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class VectorLayer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A vector layer of a dataset (OGRLayer): its fields, features, extent and coordinate system; filters (attributes, extent); new fields and features (a layer of a dataset created or opened for writing). The result of SQL (GdalDataset.executeSql(String)) must be closed.

    • setAttributeFilter

      public void setAttributeFilter(String where)
      Only the features of an attribute filter (an SQL WHERE clause, e.g. "area > 1000 AND type = 'forest'"); null: all. Some drivers (e.g., GeoPackage) check the filter only when the features are read (an invalid filter: no features).
